facts.fact: The World Bank ICR says the HRMIS built under the Education Sector Plan Support Project is now linked to the payroll, with 98.01 percent of teachers on payroll recorded in it with a certificate of presence (target 95 percent), and is used under the CARE project for teacher recruitment and deployment, while also saying it was developed, validated and piloted and that nationwide routine use is to be consolidated under CARE; the date is the document's published date, as it gives no event date.

The ICR says Component 3 financed the establishment and rollout of an HRMIS linked to the payroll and to the EMIS, alongside EMIS strengthening through digitization, geo-referencing and mobile data collection; the document gives no date for the EMIS link, so its published date is used.
